{{Otheruses|Protector}}
'''Chief Protector''', or '''Si'rin'na''' in [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]], was an honored [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] title bestowed upon a clan's best [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] ([[Protector (Rin'na)|Protector]]).

When the [[Soammei clan]] became the first dominant clan on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], its Chief Protector claimed himself [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]] or ''Inta'si'rin'na'', a title that signified rulership over all Rodians. The title was adopted by the Chief Protectors of subsequent dominant clans. Sometimes a Grand Protector would transfer power to a Chief Protector peacefully.

Chief Protectors reigned under the Grand Protectors; they were local governors of their province, with their enclaves functioning as local capitals.

As the Chief Protector became a political title, the [[Supreme Hunter]] was the title that honored the best hunter in the context of the [[Goa-Ato]].
